listing.aiSummary: Adds an end-game expansion for recovering and utilizing advanced Omega technology through weapon disassembly and assembly.

description:
Beware: spoilers.

Description

End-game focused expansion centered around recovering and utilizing the most advanced technology of the sector.

Requirements

Ashes of the Domain - VoK
LunaLib

Download

https://github.com/MildlyFootwear/starsector-AshesOfOhm/releases

In Depth

Spoiler time.

Spoiler
In brief:

Once you have obtained a certain Hyper-dimensional Processor being guarded by some less than friendly doritos...
Disassemble Omega weapons to obtain Omega components.
Use Omega components to assemble other Omega weapons or salvage Omega ships, keeping in mind that the salvaged ship variant is a far cry from the original and extremely limited in quantity, though still strong in it's own right. The weapons themselves are full fat omega weapons, albeit restricted in quantity so you can't just fit a fleet with all of them.
Currently supports all vanilla omega weapons and mod added weapons that use the omega tag.

Future plans:
Add Nexerelin starts, for example adding the Tesseract as a supership option or adding a custom start option as a disconnected AI.
Add more Remnant content options, such as Nexerelin contact Midnight offering Remnant blueprints with sufficient reputation.

Credits

Mayu and several others who worked on Special Hullmod Upgrades for letting me reuse some code for content.

aiDescription: Adds an end-game expansion focused on recovering and utilizing advanced sector technology. Players can disassemble Omega weapons to obtain components, which are then used to assemble new Omega weapons or salvage Omega ships. The mod supports vanilla and mod-added Omega weapons, with salvaged ships being limited in quantity but still powerful.
